title: Nested if
prompt: To ride the robot you must be at least 12 years old, and then at least 120 cm tall. ride_check answers "too young", "too short" or "ride".
hints: Check the age first, and only check the height inside that: an if can live inside another if, indented one level further.
`if age >= 12:` then inside it `if height >= 120:` return "ride" `else:` return "too short"; the outer `else:` returns "too young".

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
